verdict.rationale: Pipecat Cloud has a dedicated pricing page on daily.co that describes compute-based agent profiles and unlimited concurrency, so published pricing exists. However, the evidence quotes no per-minute or usage rates, so a founder could not estimate cost per call from it. The open-source framework itself is free to self-host, but third-party service costs are not addressed. Missing for 10: actual per-minute or per-session rates, a per-call cost estimation method or calculator, and guidance on bundled versus pass-through provider costs (STT/LLM/TTS/telephony).

support.subject: As a founder, I can see published per-minute or usage pricing and estimate cost per call before committing

citations.quote: Pipecat Cloud offers different agent profiles, to best support your use case and compute needs.
